marketSummary: Indian stock markets traded on a firm footing with Sensex closing above 82,100 and Nifty rising +65 points, bolstered by steady foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows and softer global crude oil prices ($90.80/bbl). Banking, realty and auto led the advance while enterprise AI deployments expanded across Indian tech hubs.

breakingNews.title: FIIs Extend November Inflows: Over ₹68,000 Crore Channeled into Domestic Equities
breakingNews.summary: Foreign institutional investors continued strong buying across large-cap banking, infrastructure and engineering companies, bolstering index sentiment.
breakingNews.simpleExplain: When overseas pension funds and financial institutions buy Indian company shares in bulk, it injects fresh cash into our stock exchange, making mutual funds and savings grow faster.
breakingNews.whyMatters: Sustained institutional buying provides liquidity cushions against global macroeconomic swings and supports the rupee.
breakingNews.realWorldExample: Strong FII inflows mean retirement funds (EPFO, NPS) and retail mutual funds see consistent net asset value appreciation.
breakingNews.opportunities: Financials, private banks, and domestic consumption sectors benefit directly from favorable liquidity conditions.
breakingNews.risks: Global rate decisions by central banks and geopolitical energy supply shifts could cause periodic volatility.

breakingNews.title: Enterprise Agentic AI Deployments Double: Global GCCs Shift Focus to Orchestration
breakingNews.summary: Enterprises are rapidly moving past generic chat interfaces toward multi-agent orchestration systems that automate workflows across software, finance, and operations.
breakingNews.simpleExplain: Instead of just asking an AI a question and getting text back, companies are now having teams of AI agents work together to research, code, test, and handle business tasks automatically.
breakingNews.whyMatters: Companies need engineers who understand how to connect business data, security checks, and automated tools to AI models rather than just basic prompting.
breakingNews.realWorldExample: A bank that used to take 3 days to verify loan documents now runs an autonomous verification agent pipeline that checks compliance in minutes.
breakingNews.opportunities: Software developers who learn API orchestration, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks are commanding premium compensation.
breakingNews.risks: Routine support and template coding positions continue to contract as automation matures.

breakingNews.title: Crude Oil Softens Near $90/bbl; Gold & Silver Consolidate as Safe-Haven Demand Settles
breakingNews.summary: Brent crude dipped 1% to $90.80 a barrel, aiding oil-importing nations like India, while domestic bullion rates held firm at ₹1,39,200 per 10 grams.
breakingNews.simpleExplain: When global oil gets cheaper, Indian transport and manufacturing costs decrease, which keeps domestic inflation low. Meanwhile, gold remains a steady store of value.
breakingNews.whyMatters: Every $1 drop in crude oil prices reduces India's import bill and lowers government subsidy burdens, strengthening fiscal headroom.
breakingNews.realWorldExample: Lower oil prices help prevent hikes in fuel and logistics prices, keeping everyday consumer goods and groceries more affordable.
breakingNews.opportunities: Aviation, paints, and logistics companies usually see margin expansions when oil prices moderate.
breakingNews.risks: Currency fluctuations and Middle East shipping lanes remain key factors to monitor.
